concerns.text: FR-003 mandates training a Random Forest 'explicitly including Species as a categorical feature'. T020A (Model A) implements a 'Soil-Only' model excluding Species. While Model B (T020B) satisfies FR-003, the task list presents Model A as a primary deliverable without clarifying that it is an auxiliary comparison, risking the implementation of a model that violates the core functional requirement if Model B is skipped or deprioritized.

SC-003 requires measuring the 'standard deviation of R² across the LOSO folds'. T020A and T020B only calculate 'observed_r2' (mean). T024 demands writing 'loso_r2_sd' to the JSON artifact, but no task explicitly defines the logic to extract per-fold R² values from the LOSO loop and compute the standard deviation. This creates a semantic gap where the acceptance criterion (SC-003) cannot be satisfied by the defined tasks.

SC-002 requires a permutation test p-value < 0.05 AND ΔR² ≥ 0.05. T022 generates the distribution data, but T023 is marked incomplete and described as 'Execute/Validate SC-002 compliance'. The task lacks explicit instructions to calculate the p-value from the distribution and enforce the hard stop (raise error or flag failure) if the criteria are not met. Without this explicit enforcement step, the success criterion is not preserved in the task logic.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums for derived datasets. T012 claims to 'produce a derived dataset file... with a checksum', but T012b (the verification step) is marked incomplete. If T012 is marked complete while T012b is not, the chain of custody for the checksum is broken, violating the requirement that checksums be verified and logged before downstream consumption (T014).

T029 requires reading `research.md` to extract citations. T035 generates `research.md`. While T035 is listed in a 'Supplement' phase, the execution order section does not explicitly enforce T035 -> T029 as a hard dependency in the sequential graph. If T029 runs before T035, it will fail with FileNotFoundError, violating the requirement to produce a report with verified citations.
